text:
Sam Onboarding: FYI — trial customer (Redwood Health) sent a quick list of onboarding friction points this morning. Pasting their note below.
Maria CS: copy, thanks. this looks like it's blocking a wider rollout for them.
Customer (Redwood Health): "Quick pain points from our integration so far:
1) Admin console: can't filter by route + model at the same time — makes debugging noisy.
2) Need per-route token budgeting in the UI so product managers can set limits per feature.
3) Setup guide missing a GCP KMS key-rotation example — we worry about ops.
4) Latency spikes when batch_size > 8 on Dedicated — intermittent, hurts UX.

Would love an ETA or workaround, otherwise we may pause the rollout."
Taylor PM: tagging product — @Jon Eng / @Ajay (Solutions) — can we triage these and propose timelines? Which are quick wins vs infra work?
Jon Eng: short answers: console filter = mostly frontend + small API change, ~3 dev-days. per-route token budgeting = needs backend counters + UI, medium effort (2-3 sprints). latency spike — needs profiling, could be infra or model variant fallback. key-rotation doc = docs + snippet, trivial.
Ajay (Solutions): they offered session recordings and sample traces. recommend we surface a documented interim workaround: use tags + export to filter until UI fix is shipped. also we can provide a manual token monitor script.
Maria CS: account note — renewal conversation in Q4 but they said "would not expand further until this is smoother". risk = medium-high if no quick win.
Taylor PM: proposed triage/prioritization: P0 = console filter (quick visible win), P1 = docs + key rotation example, P2 = per-route token budgeting, P1 = latency investigation (fast spike triage). @Sam Onboarding can you confirm customer urgency and get recordings/traces?
feedback-bot: Created ticket INF-4823 for "latency spikes when batch_size > 8" and linked to the thread.
Sam Onboarding: uploading their session and a short export (link below). I'll ask for exact timestamps of bad calls. https://redwood.cust/rec/abc123
Jon Eng: I'll take the latency spike spike tomorrow AM. plan: reproduce with their payload, run profiler, check KV cache behavior and batch kernel paths. will update by EOD.
Taylor PM: if console filter is 3 days, we can ship a limited rollout to this customer and call it a win. I'll put a GH issue with acceptance criteria. small QA: filter by route+model + save view.
Maria CS: I'll schedule a 30-min call with the customer for tomorrow to propose the interim workaround and get traces. also capturing their exact ask for per-route budgeting (hard limit vs soft alert?).
Sam Onboarding: perfect — I'll run the call and offer the workaround + timeline. will post notes here after.
Jon Eng: one more FYI — if we see KV cache cold-start on Dedicated, a short-term mitigation is to warm caches on deploys for affected pools.
Taylor PM: thanks all. next steps: Sam -> customer call, Maria -> capture exact budgeting requirements, Jon -> latency spike spike, me -> create GH issues and label priorities. :thumbsup:
Sam Onboarding: On it. will update after call. :pray:
